_documentation.format_version: Template format revision, written automatically. Missing means legacy revision 1; unsupported revisions are rejected. Do not change it manually.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyebrows: Top-left positions of the two 4x4 slanted eyebrow masks on the 16x16 head face. Coordinates are whole pixels 0-12; move eyebrows independently from the eyes. Missing settings keep the original positions. Preview face glow is brighter for alignment; fight brightness is unchanged.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyebrows.left_y: Left eyebrow Y, 0-12; default 2. Larger values move down.
_documentation.skin.glowing_pupils: Darker rectangles inside the eyes. Offsets start at each eye's top-left, so moving an eye also moves its pupil. -1 automatically follows the inner X or bottom Y edge. Size and position clamp to the eye. Missing settings retain the original one-pixel pupil; automatic pupils stay hidden on one-pixel-wide/high eyes.
_documentation.skin.glowing_pupils.enabled: Show darker pupils. false leaves the entire eye glow bright.
_documentation.skin.glowing_pupils.scale_x: Horizontal pupil scale, 0.5-8; 1 = one atlas pixel. Rounded to 1-8 whole pixels and clipped to eye width. Both pupils share the width.
_documentation.skin.glowing_pupils.scale_y: Vertical pupil scale, 0.5-8; 1 = one atlas pixel. Rounded to 1-8 whole pixels and clipped to eye height. X/Y sizes are independent.
_documentation.skin.glowing_pupils.left_x: Left pupil X offset inside its eye, whole number -1 to 7; -1 = automatic inner edge. 0 starts at the eye's left edge.
_documentation.skin.glowing_pupils.left_y: Left pupil Y offset inside its eye, whole number -1 to 7; -1 = automatic bottom edge. Larger values move down.
_documentation.skin.glowing_pupils.right_x: Right pupil X offset inside its eye, whole number -1 to 7; -1 = automatic inner edge. 0 starts at the eye's left edge.
_documentation.skin.glowing_pupils.right_y: Right pupil Y offset inside its eye, whole number -1 to 7; -1 = automatic bottom edge. Larger values move down.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyes: Eye positions on the 16x16 front head face, measured in Warden atlas pixels from its top-left. Default eyes are 2x2 with one darker pupil; independent X/Y scales change their size; eyebrows use their separate position settings. Use the editor skin preview to align them. These coordinates affect only marked bosses.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyes.scale_x: Horizontal eye scale, 0.5-4; 1 = two pixels wide. Rounded to whole atlas pixels (1-8) without blur. Both eyes share the width; Y scale is independent.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyes.scale_y: Vertical eye scale, 0.5-4; 1 = two pixels tall. Rounded to whole atlas pixels (1-8) without blur. Both eyes share the height; X scale is independent.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyes.left_x: Left eye horizontal position, whole number 0-15; default 3. The rendered position is clamped so the scaled eye fits on the face. One step = one atlas pixel.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyes.left_y: Left eye vertical position, whole number 0-15; default 7. The rendered position is clamped so the scaled eye fits on the face. Larger values move down.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyes.right_x: Right eye horizontal position, whole number 0-15; default 11. The rendered position is clamped so the scaled eye fits on the face.
_documentation.skin.glowing_eyes.right_y: Right eye vertical position, whole number 0-15; default 7. The rendered position is clamped so the scaled eye fits on the face.
_documentation.music: Encounter music starts on activation for players in the arena; entrants join and leavers fade out. One track plays per client, with the most recently entered ready encounter taking priority. Put its OGG Vorbis file in this template's sounds folder. Mono or stereo works; the selected native sound channel controls volume. No track is included by default.
_documentation.music.channel: Native sound channel: music (default), record (Jukebox/Note Blocks), master (Master only), or another Minecraft category. Master still affects every channel. GUI changes and /stopsound use this category.
_documentation.music.enabled: true enables configured music; false disables it. A blank filename also disables playback.
_documentation.music.file: One lowercase .ogg basename, such as boss_music.ogg; no spaces, capitals or paths. Maximum 8 MiB minus 1 KiB, ten minutes. The server validates and sends the compressed track in bounded chunks; slow clients start when it arrives.
_documentation.music.volume: Volume 0-4, multiplied by the player's Music/master sliders; default 0.75. Zero disables playback.
_documentation.music.loop: true repeats until encounter end; false plays once per arena entry. Late entrants start the track from its beginning, not the boss's playback position.
_documentation.music.fade_out_seconds: Fade duration 0-10 seconds on death, removal, unload or leaving the arena; default 2. Zero stops immediately. Reload refreshes music. Disconnect stops immediately and frees cached audio.
_documentation.skin: Base texture; player colors use nearest-neighbor scaling. Only glow layers are tinted. Custom: 128x128 Warden atlas in this template folder's skins/, at most 512 KiB; sent to tracking clients. Install the same mod version on both sides.
_documentation.skin.type: "player": account skin (blank name uses vanilla); "default": vanilla Warden; "custom": server PNG.
_documentation.skin.name: Minecraft username for player skins; 1-16 letters, numbers or underscores.
_documentation.skin.file: Lowercase PNG filename only, e.g. clockwork_warden.png; no spaces, capitals or directory path.
_documentation.spawn: Per-template spawn saved by /boss setspawn <template>. X/Z bounded to +/-30,000,000; Y to build height with room for the scaled underground holding position.
_documentation.spawn.set: true uses saved position/dimension; false uses the command source.
_documentation.health: Marked boss maximum health, 1-1,000,000 points (2 points = 1 heart). Native health, damage, healing, save and sync stay in use. Health modifiers retain native math; the final maximum is bounded to this range. Ordinary entities keep their vanilla limits. Reload preserves the current health fraction; loading a saved boss preserves its saved health.
_documentation.movement_speed: Base movement attribute, 0-1; phases can override.
_documentation.knockback_resistance: 0 = none, 1 = full resistance; phases can override.
_documentation.follow_range: 0 = automatic arena range (default): boss-centered radius or full box diagonal, capped at 256 blocks. No arena uses 24 blocks. Positive 1-256 sets an explicit detection/follow distance. Computed on phase assignment/reload, not each tick.
_documentation.scale: Size multiplier, 0.25-4; 1 = normal. Dormant depth grows with size.
_documentation.warden_effects: Emissive glow and transition effects; base skin colors stay unchanged.
_documentation.warden_effects.color: Glow tint as #RRGGBB; each phase can override.
_documentation.warden_effects.phase_change: One-time effects on a health-phase transition, including healing. Initial spawn/reload assignment is silent.
_documentation.warden_effects.phase_change.flash: Enable the brief white glow flash (8 client ticks).
_documentation.warden_effects.phase_change.particle_exp: One burst of small dust particles in the entering phase color; client particle settings may reduce visibility.
Dust size, 0.1-4; smaller values make finer particles.
_documentation.sounds: OGG Vorbis files in this template folder's sounds/ on the server; never shared with another template. Lowercase ASCII filenames only; no spaces, capitals or paths. Limit: 1 MiB minus 1 KiB and 30 seconds. MP3/WAV unsupported. Reload after file edits. Use mono for directional sound at the boss; stereo lacks normal 3D positioning. Long clips stay where they started. Bounded transfer/validation protects slow clients; first-use playback may be delayed.
_documentation.sounds.spawn: Plays once when the boss activates and begins emerging, not on /boss spawn.
_documentation.sounds.phase_change: Shared fallback for actual phase transitions; initial spawn/reload phase assignment plays no phase sound. Null/missing phase fields inherit; an explicit filename wins even if missing. An empty phase file disables that transition.
_documentation.sounds.death: Plays when the boss dies; /boss remove does not play it.
_documentation.voice_lines: Random attack voices from this template folder's sounds/voice-lines/. Each template has its own clips. Successful melee/Sonic Boom hits roll once; one voice at a time per boss. Up to 64 direct lowercase .ogg files, using the sound size/duration rules. Add files then /boss reload. Use mono for directional sound; long clips stay where they started.
_documentation.voice_lines.enabled: Enable attack voice lines; an empty folder is silent.
_documentation.voice_lines.chance: Probability per eligible successful hit, 0-1; 0.25 = 25%. Busy voices skip the roll.
_documentation.voice_lines.volume: Volume multiplier, 0-4; follows the client Hostile slider.
_documentation.voice_lines.pitch: Pitch multiplier, 0.5-2; adjusts the non-overlap duration too.
_documentation.voice_lines.range: 0 = automatic arena diagonal/radius (32 without an arena); positive distance is manual, capped at 512 blocks.
_documentation.attacks: Base attacks; per-phase values override them. Minecraft handles targeting and navigation.
_documentation.attacks.melee: Native melee uses this base policy unless overridden by the current phase. Each attempt applies the health-selected phase before reading native damage/knockback, permission and cooldown. The current phase delay is measured from the last successful hit; blocked hits do not reset it.
_documentation.attacks.melee.enabled: Allow melee. false lets enabled Sonic Boom attack inside melee reach.
_documentation.attacks.melee.cooldown_ticks: Minimum delay between successful hits, 1-1,000,000 ticks.
_documentation.attacks.sonic_boom: New charges use the current phase. A started charge retains all its original settings through phase changes, healing and reload, even if the next phase disables Sonic Boom. A lost, switched, dead, removed, out-of-range or obstructed target cancels the charge; unload clears it.
_documentation.attacks.sonic_boom.requires_line_of_sigh: true prevents starting/hitting through solid obstructions.
_documentation.attacks.sonic_boom.charge_time_ticks: Windup 0-1,000,000 ticks. Captured shot timing drives native windup keyframes: shorter is faster, longer is slower. Zero fires immediately. Normal-speed recoil is visual only; cooldown remains independent. Native charge sound keeps normal pitch/duration and can end before a long windup.
_documentation.phases: 1-16 stages in file order (first to last). Each non-final stage leaves at its minimum_health_percent cutoff; the final stage covers remaining health. Cutoffs descend from 100 toward 0. The editor can add, remove or reorder stages. Defaults remain ANNOYED >75%, AGITATED >50%-75%, ENRAGED >25%-50%, FURY <=25%. 20 ticks = 1 second.
_documentation.phases.<phase>: Health stage in fight order. Null/missing settings inherit base values. The final stage's cutoff is ignored.
_documentation.phases.annoyed: Initial active phase; cyan glow by default. Underground Darkness is configured separately in dormant_darkness.
_documentation.phases.agitated: Second phase; yellow glow by default.
_documentation.phases.enraged: Third phase; orange glow by default.
_documentation.phases.fury: Final phase; red glow by default. No separate terminal cutoff.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.minimum_health_percent: Leave this stage at or below this health percentage: 0-100, descending in fight order. The final stage does not use a cutoff.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.movement_speed: Phase movement attribute, 0-1; null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.follow_range: null/missing inherits base. 0 uses automatic arena range; positive 1-256 overrides detection/follow distance. Automatic box coverage assumes the boss stays inside the arena.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.sounds: Sound overrides for entering this phase.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.sounds.phase_change: Null/missing fields inherit sounds.phase_change individually; blank file disables this transition.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.sounds.phase_change.file: Entering-phase OGG filename, e.g. phase2.ogg; match exact case/spelling. null inherits; "" disables.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.sounds.phase_change.range: 0: automatic arena radius/box diagonal; positive: manual blocks, maximum 512; null inherits.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.melee: Overrides attacks.melee; null/missing fields inherit. New melee attempts use this phase permission, cooldown and native attributes together.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.sonic_boom: Overrides attacks.sonic_boom; null/missing fields inherit. Changes apply to the next charge; an in-progress charge keeps its start-time settings.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.warden_effects: Phase glow; missing color/transition settings inherit base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.warden_effects.phase_chan: Phase-specific flash/burst; null/missing fields inherit base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness: Active phase aura after emergence. Defaults increase coverage from 1-2 seconds every 10 seconds in phase 1 to continuous coverage in Fury. Timing and duration blend with distance; stronger existing Darkness is respected.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness.enabled: false stops new applications/refreshes; existing Darkness expires normally. null/missing inherits the legacy base or safe default.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness.max_radius: Spherical radius in blocks including height, 0-256; 0 disables. null/missing inherits the legacy base or safe default.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness.edge_interval_ti: Refresh eligibility at outer edge, 1-12000 ticks; 200 = 10 seconds. Shorter intervals allow more frequent refreshes.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness.center_interval_: Refresh eligibility at boss, 1-12000 ticks; 20 = 1 second. Existing effects refresh when half-duration remains.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness.edge_duration_ti: Effect length at edge, 1-12000 ticks; 20 = 1 second. Duration below interval creates gaps.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness.center_duration_: Effect length at boss, 1-12000 ticks; 40 = 2 seconds. For continuity use at least twice interval plus scan margin.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness.edge_amplifier: Keep at 0. Priority between overlapping Darkness effects only; does not increase visual darkness or set priority against Night Vision. Edge effect priority, 0-4; 0 = level I. Higher does not make the screen darker. null/missing inherits the legacy base or safe default.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.darkness.center_amplifier: Keep at 0. Priority between overlapping Darkness effects only; does not increase visual darkness or set priority against Night Vision. Center effect priority, 0-4; blended toward edge with distance. 0 = normal. null/missing inherits the legacy base or safe default.
_documentation.darkness: Legacy base aura fallback; missing phase fields inherit it. Prefer per-phase settings.
_documentation.boss_bar: Boss bar after activation; /boss select arena <template> sets its shared visibility and player-effect area. No selected area means no bar.
_documentation.boss_bar.color: PINK, BLUE, RED, GREEN, YELLOW, PURPLE or WHITE.
_documentation.boss_bar.overlay: PROGRESS, NOTCHED_6, NOTCHED_10, NOTCHED_12 or NOTCHED_20.
_documentation.boss_bar.visibility_area: Who sees the bar and receives configured area effects after activation. Choose a saved box or a 3D radius that follows this Warden. The existing ten-tick watcher checks both; no additional timer. Missing box bounds leave box visibility unset.
_documentation.boss_bar.visibility_area.shape: "box": use saved min/max/dimension; "radius": use radius around the Warden, ignoring min/max.
_documentation.boss_bar.visibility_area.dimension: Dimension ID. Radius mode with an empty value follows the Warden in its current dimension; box mode requires the saved box dimension. A specified dimension restricts either mode.
_documentation.boss_bar.visibility_area.min: Lower inclusive block corner: x, y, z.
_documentation.boss_bar.visibility_area.max: Upper inclusive block corner: x, y, z.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects: Infinite buffs only after activation, while inside the boss-bar area. Removed on exit/end; other-source effects take priority. Overlapping areas use highest level. Haste unsupported.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.enabled: Master switch for individually enabled buffs below.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.regeneration: Regeneration: healing; higher levels heal more often.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.resistance: Resistance: -20% affected damage per level; level V blocks all affected damage. Some damage bypasses it.
_documentation.activation: Dormant trigger. Choose an entry box, an emergence-centered entry radius, or redstone. /boss select activation <template> saves a box; optional true also saves the boss-bar box. /boss activate <name> triggers manually. Existing occupants at spawn or after trigger edits must leave/reenter; uses the existing ten-tick watcher.
_documentation.activation.type: "player_enter_area": saved-box entry; "player_enter_radius": radius entry; "redstone": rising signal.
_documentation.activation.shape: "box" for player_enter_area selections; ignored for player_enter_radius and redstone.
_documentation.activation.dimension: Dimension containing the trigger; empty uses the spawned boss dimension. Malformed dimension IDs disable the trigger.
_documentation.activation.min: Lower inclusive block corner: x, y, z; each box side <=256 blocks.
_documentation.activation.max: Upper inclusive block corner: x, y, z; each box side <=256 blocks.
_documentation.activation.position: Redstone trigger block: x, y, z.
_documentation.sounds.spawn.file: Exact OGG filename, e.g. boss_phase.ogg; "" disables.
_documentation.sounds.spawn.volume: Volume multiplier, 0-4; also follows the client Hostile slider.
_documentation.sounds.spawn.range: 0 = automatic arena diagonal/radius (32 without an arena); positive distance is manual, capped at 512 blocks.
_documentation.sounds.phase_change.file: Exact OGG filename, e.g. boss_phase.ogg; "" disables.
_documentation.sounds.phase_change.volume: Volume multiplier, 0-4; also follows the client Hostile slider.
_documentation.sounds.phase_change.range: 0 = automatic arena diagonal/radius (32 without an arena); positive distance is manual, capped at 512 blocks.
_documentation.sounds.death.file: Exact OGG filename, e.g. boss_phase.ogg; "" disables.
_documentation.sounds.death.volume: Volume multiplier, 0-4; also follows the client Hostile slider.
_documentation.sounds.death.range: 0 = automatic arena diagonal/radius (32 without an arena); positive distance is manual, capped at 512 blocks.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.speed.enabled: Enable this buff when the master switch is true.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.speed.level: Effect level, 1-5 (1 = I); invalid/fractional values use 1.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.jump_boost.enabled: Enable this buff when the master switch is true.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.jump_boost.level: Effect level, 1-5 (1 = I); invalid/fractional values use 1.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.regeneration.enabl: Enable this buff when the master switch is true.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.regeneration.level: Effect level, 1-5 (1 = I); invalid/fractional values use 1.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.strength.enabled: Enable this buff when the master switch is true.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.strength.level: Effect level, 1-5 (1 = I); invalid/fractional values use 1.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.resistance.enabled: Enable this buff when the master switch is true.
_documentation.boss_bar.area_effects.resistance.level: Effect level, 1-5 (1 = I); invalid/fractional values use 1.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.melee.enabled: Allow melee. false lets enabled Sonic Boom attack inside melee reach.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.melee.cooldown_ticks: Minimum delay between successful hits, 1-1,000,000 ticks.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.sonic_boom.requires_line_: true prevents starting/hitting through solid obstructions.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.sonic_boom.charge_time_ti: Captured windup in ticks, 0-1,000,000; null inherits base. Native windup animation follows this shot duration. No mandatory recovery or cooldown extension; native charge audio is not stretched.
_documentation.darkness.enabled: false stops new applications/refreshes; existing Darkness expires normally.
_documentation.darkness.max_radius: Spherical radius in blocks including height, 0-256; 0 disables.
_documentation.darkness.edge_interval_ticks: Refresh eligibility at outer edge, 1-12000 ticks; 200 = 10 seconds. Shorter intervals allow more frequent refreshes.
_documentation.darkness.center_interval_ticks: Refresh eligibility at boss, 1-12000 ticks; 20 = 1 second. Existing effects refresh when half-duration remains.
_documentation.darkness.edge_duration_ticks: Effect length at edge, 1-12000 ticks; 20 = 1 second. Duration below interval creates gaps.
_documentation.darkness.center_duration_ticks: Effect length at boss, 1-12000 ticks; 40 = 2 seconds. For continuity use at least twice interval plus scan margin.
_documentation.darkness.edge_amplifier: Keep at 0. Priority between overlapping Darkness effects only; does not increase visual darkness or set priority against Night Vision. Edge effect priority, 0-4; 0 = level I. Higher does not make the screen darker.
_documentation.darkness.center_amplifier: Keep at 0. Priority between overlapping Darkness effects only; does not increase visual darkness or set priority against Night Vision. Center effect priority, 0-4; blended toward edge with distance. 0 = normal.
_documentation.dormant_darkness: Underground aura before activation: defaults give 1-2 seconds of Darkness every 10 seconds, depending on distance. Independent of active phases. Center is the hidden boss position; no aura during emergence. Missing/null fields inherit phase 1. Existing effects expire normally.
_documentation.dormant_darkness.enabled: false stops new applications/refreshes; existing Darkness expires normally. null/missing inherits phase 1.
_documentation.dormant_darkness.max_radius: Spherical radius in blocks including height, 0-256; 0 disables. null/missing inherits phase 1.
_documentation.dormant_darkness.edge_interval_ticks: Refresh eligibility at outer edge, 1-12000 ticks; 200 = 10 seconds. Shorter intervals allow more frequent refreshes.
_documentation.dormant_darkness.center_interval_ticks: Refresh eligibility at boss, 1-12000 ticks; 20 = 1 second. Existing effects refresh when half-duration remains.
_documentation.dormant_darkness.edge_duration_ticks: Effect length at edge, 1-12000 ticks; 20 = 1 second. Duration below interval creates gaps.
_documentation.dormant_darkness.center_duration_ticks: Effect length at boss, 1-12000 ticks; 40 = 2 seconds. For continuity use at least twice interval plus scan margin.
_documentation.dormant_darkness.edge_amplifier: Keep at 0. Priority between overlapping Darkness effects only; does not increase visual darkness or set priority against Night Vision. Edge effect priority, 0-4; 0 = level I. Higher does not make the screen darker. null/missing inherits phase 1.
_documentation.dormant_darkness.center_amplifier: Keep at 0. Priority between overlapping Darkness effects only; does not increase visual darkness or set priority against Night Vision. Center effect priority, 0-4; blended toward edge with distance. 0 = normal. null/missing inherits phase 1.
_documentation.sounds.mob_volume: Native Warden sound multiplier: 0 = mute, 0.25 = quarter volume (default), 1 = vanilla volume. Includes ambient, hurt/death, steps, roar, heartbeat and Sonic Boom. Custom OGG events and voice lines keep their separate volume settings. /boss reload applies edits.
_documentation.boss_bar.visibility_area.radius: Radius in blocks, 1-256 (default 32); used only for shape "radius". True 3D distance from the Warden position, not a horizontal cylinder.
_documentation.activation.radius: Radius in blocks, 1-256 (default 32), used for type "player_enter_radius". True 3D distance from the saved emergence position; underground depth/scale does not move the trigger. Box min/max and shape are ignored in this mode.
_documentation.targeting: Completed swings and fired beams count toward target rotation. Hold time and minimum attacks gate chance rolls; the maximum forces a different eligible opponent. Solo fights keep their target. Cancelled beams and disabled/cooldown-rejected swings do not count. No additional watcher.
_documentation.targeting.switch_chance: Chance to switch targets after the minimum attacks/time: 0% switches only at the maximum; 100% switches at the first eligible completion. Default 50%. The maximum forces rotation regardless of chance when an alternative exists.
_documentation.targeting.mode: Choose nearest, random (default), or farthest alternative. Players must be inside the arena and natively eligible. Melee rotation uses follow range; ranged rotation uses the fired beam horizontal/vertical range. Unset arena uses that attack range.
_documentation.targeting.announcement: Show the actual new target to that player and arena viewers. A personal warning can replace a recent audience warning about someone else. Personal warnings still share a recipient cooldown across bosses. Same-target assignments stay silent; skipped titles are not queued.
_documentation.targeting.announcement.enabled: Enable dramatic target titles. This never postpones attacks or adds recovery time.
_documentation.targeting.announcement.text: Literal text, at most 80 characters; <player> becomes the actual account name. Default: RUN, <player>!. No JSON formatting or commands.
_documentation.targeting.announcement.cooldown_ticks: Recipient cooldown, 20-1200 ticks; default 60. Also covers title display/fades. A new target bypasses an audience-only warning; recent personal warnings still throttle across bosses.
_documentation.targeting.announcement.display_ticks: Hold title 1-100 ticks (default 20), plus 2-tick fade in and 4-tick fade out.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting: Per-phase target controls; null fields inherit base settings.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.switch_chance: Chance to switch targets after the minimum attacks/time: 0% switches only at the maximum; 100% switches at the first eligible completion. Default 50%. The maximum forces rotation regardless of chance when an alternative exists. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.mode: Choose nearest, random (default), or farthest alternative. Players must be inside the arena and natively eligible. Melee rotation uses follow range; ranged rotation uses the fired beam horizontal/vertical range. Unset arena uses that attack range. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.announcement.en: Enable dramatic target titles. This never postpones attacks or adds recovery time. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.announcement.te: Literal text, at most 80 characters; <player> becomes the actual account name. Default: RUN, <player>!. No JSON formatting or commands. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.announcement.co: Recipient cooldown, 20-1200 ticks; default 60. Also covers title display/fades. A new target bypasses an audience-only warning; recent personal warnings still throttle across bosses. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.announcement.di: Hold title 1-100 ticks (default 20), plus 2-tick fade in and 4-tick fade out. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.targeting.min_target_ticks: Minimum time on one valid target, 0-12000 ticks; default 60 = 3 seconds. Checked on assignments/completed attacks without a timer. Dead, disconnected, removed or ineligible targets can be replaced immediately. Time takes priority over maximum attacks.
_documentation.targeting.min_attacks: Completed attacks on the same target before chance rolls, whole number 1-1000; default 1. Counts melee swings (including blocked hits) and fired beams, not cancelled windups.
_documentation.targeting.max_attacks: Force rotation after this many completed attacks, whole number 1-1000; default 4. Must be at least min_attacks. Hold time or no alternative can exceed this count; switch at the next eligible completion. Counts reset on an actual target change, not each phase.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.announcement: Show the actual new target to that player and arena viewers. A personal warning can replace a recent audience warning about someone else. Personal warnings still share a recipient cooldown across bosses. Same-target assignments stay silent; skipped titles are not queued. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.min_target_tick: Minimum time on one valid target, 0-12000 ticks; default 60 = 3 seconds. Checked on assignments/completed attacks without a timer. Dead, disconnected, removed or ineligible targets can be replaced immediately. Time takes priority over maximum attacks. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.min_attacks: Completed attacks on the same target before chance rolls, whole number 1-1000; default 1. Counts melee swings (including blocked hits) and fired beams, not cancelled windups. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.targeting.max_attacks: Force rotation after this many completed attacks, whole number 1-1000; default 4. Must be at least min_attacks. Hold time or no alternative can exceed this count; switch at the next eligible completion. Counts reset on an actual target change, not each phase. null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.attacks.melee.charge_time_ticks: Wind-up before the native hit, whole number 0-12000 ticks. 0 keeps immediate hits. Longer wind-ups stretch the built-in swing; target/phase/reload changes can cancel it.
_documentation.attacks.melee.recovery_time_ticks: Built-in swing recovery after impact, whole number 0-12000 ticks; default 4. Recovery and the captured attack cooldown must finish before another melee swing.
_documentation.attacks.sonic_boom.recovery_time_ticks: Built-in Sonic Boom recovery after firing, whole number 0-12000 ticks; default 26. The next beam waits for both recovery and its captured cooldown.
_documentation.attacks.roar: Default sound for roar interludes; this section alone does not trigger a roar. Minecraft owns the roar animation/activity (about 84 ticks), then the next subphase begins.
_documentation.attacks.roar.sound: Optional mono OGG in this template's sounds folder. Sent through the existing bounded media path and played at the boss. Blank file uses the vanilla roar.
_documentation.attacks.roar.sound.file: Lowercase OGG basename, no spaces or paths. Blank uses the native Warden roar; child/phase null inherits the parent sound.
_documentation.attacks.roar.sound.range: 0 = automatic arena diagonal/radius (default); positive distance is manual, capped at 512 blocks. Null phase/child values inherit.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.subphases: Optional 0-16 attack or recovery entries inside this health phase. Empty disables the sequence. Sequential follows file order; random shuffles every entry once per round. Recovery pauses attacks and movement. Main-phase entry/reload resets it; no nested children or health cutoffs.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.subphases.<subphase>: Choose attack or recovery. Attack combat values inherit parent phase then base; recovery uses only duration_ticks. Parent health, scale, glow, aura and phase events stay unchanged. Hidden combat fields are retained when changing type in the editor.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.subphases.<subphase>.atta: Completed attacks before a roar/next subphase, whole number 1-1000; default 3. Blocked swings count; cancelled/disabled/cooldown-rejected attacks do not.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.roar: Sound defaults inherited by this phase's roar list; does not trigger a main-phase roar.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.melee.charge_time_ticks: Wind-up before the native hit, whole number 0-12000 ticks. 0 keeps immediate hits. Longer wind-ups stretch the built-in swing; target/phase/reload changes can cancel it. Null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.melee.recovery_time_ticks: Built-in swing recovery after impact, whole number 0-12000 ticks; default 4. Recovery and the captured attack cooldown must finish before another melee swing. Null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.sonic_boom.recovery_time_: Built-in Sonic Boom recovery after firing, whole number 0-12000 ticks; default 26. The next beam waits for both recovery and its captured cooldown. Null/missing inherits base.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.roar.sound: Optional mono OGG in this template's sounds folder. Sent through the existing bounded media path and played at the boss. Blank file uses the vanilla roar.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.roar.sound.file: Lowercase OGG basename, no spaces or paths. Blank uses the native Warden roar; child/phase null inherits the parent sound.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.roar.sound.range: 0 = automatic arena diagonal/radius (default); positive distance is manual, capped at 512 blocks. Null phase/child values inherit.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.subphase_order: sequential: visit subphases in file order and cycle the roar list independently. random: run each subphase once in shuffled order, then reshuffle; pick a random roar at each transition. No immediate subphase repeats when there are at least two.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.roar_between_subphases: When true and the roar list is nonempty, pause attacks and play one native roar after each subphase, including the loop boundary. False or an empty roar list skips interludes.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.roars: Optional 0-16 roar sounds between subphases. Sequential cycles this list independently: one repeats, two alternate, four pair with four subphases. Random picks one per transition; roars may repeat. No missing-slot inheritance rule is needed.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.roars.<roar>: One native roar interlude. Sound fields inherit the parent phase roar defaults, then base attacks.roar. Blank file uses the vanilla roar; a custom filename with volume 0 gives a silent animation.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.subphases.<subphase>.type: attack: inherited combat settings until the attack count is reached. recovery: stop movement and attacks for duration_ticks, then advance. Roars remain in the separate ordered roar list.
_documentation.phases.<phase>.subphases.<subphase>.dura: Recovery length, whole number 1-12000 ticks; default 60 (3 seconds). Ignored for attack entries. Uses game time; no separate watcher.
_documentation.boss_bar.player_health: Active arena participants only. Raises maximum health to a minimum; armor that already grants more stays unchanged. Exit/reentry preserves the current health percentage.
_documentation.boss_bar.player_health.enabled: Enable the health minimum independently of beacon effects; default true in new templates. Missing section in older files is disabled.
_documentation.boss_bar.player_health.minimum_max_healt: Minimum maximum HP, 1-1000; default 100 HP (50 hearts). This is a floor, not extra health added to armor.
_documentation.boss_bar.player_health.heal_on_first_ent: Fully heal once per player per encounter, including late arrivals. Reentry, reconnect and reload do not repeat it. Saved on the boss; capped at 4096 participants.
_documentation.boss_bar.reusable_potion: Give an owner-bound offhand potion during an active encounter. Uses normal drinking time; bottle is reusable. An occupied offhand moves into a free inventory slot; full inventory prevents the gift.
_documentation.boss_bar.reusable_potion.enabled: Enable the potion independently of beacon effects and fight health. Default true in new templates; absent section is disabled.
_documentation.boss_bar.reusable_potion.heal_hp: HP restored after drinking, 0-1000; default 20 HP (10 hearts). Cannot exceed current max health.
_documentation.boss_bar.reusable_potion.cooldown_second: Time after a completed drink before another dose, 0.05-600 game seconds; default 15. Shared by all copies and overlapping encounters; survives exit, reconnect and respawn.
_documentation.boss_bar.reusable_potion.hunger_restored: Hunger points added, whole number 0-20; default 20. Food level is capped at 20.
_documentation.boss_bar.reusable_potion.saturation_rest: Saturation points added, 0-20; default 20. Saturation is capped at the resulting food level.
_documentation.loot: Template-owned reward table. Each item entry rolls independently once at real death. Respects doMobLoot; removal, reset and /kill never pay.
_documentation.loot.enabled: Enable the extra loot-table roll. Missing/false keeps existing behavior. Saving does not change a live boss; use Reload.
_documentation.loot.loot_table: Loaded server datapack ID, used only when source is table. The GUI retains it when switching to entries.
_documentation.loot.vanilla_drops: keep adds configured rewards to native Warden table drops. replace skips that table. XP, equipment and independent mod drops remain native.
_documentation.loot.source: entries: create/edit item rewards in the GUI. table: use a loaded server datapack table. Switching sources retains both definitions.
_documentation.loot.entries: 0–32 named rewards. Add items with the searchable inventory picker; Edit sets quantity and chance. Empty gives no custom items.
_documentation.loot.entries.<entry>.type: item: a plain registered item. Reserved reward-kind field for later extensions.
_documentation.loot.entries.<entry>.item: Registered item ID; vanilla and mod items work. The visual picker selects a default item, without enchantments or extra components.
_documentation.loot.entries.<entry>.min_count: Minimum quantity, 1–64. Must not exceed maximum.
_documentation.loot.entries.<entry>.max_count: Maximum quantity, 1–64. Uniform random quantity between minimum and maximum, inclusive.
_documentation.loot.entries.<entry>.chance: Independent drop chance, 0–1 in files or 0–100% in GUI. 0 never drops; 1 always drops.
